item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00073","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C15","C21","C02"],"selected_candidate_label":"C15","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C15 is a highly plausible direct drafting template. Both orders transfer Defense functions to NASA using the distinctive parenthetical definition “including powers, duties, activities, and parts of functions,” then provide for associated transfers of appropriations, records, and property. The child adapts this machinery to Jet Propulsion Laboratory functions and adds exclusions, interagency arrangements, and a specified funding amount. C21 and C02 share transfer structures but lack C15’s unusually close combination of language, agencies, and ancillary machinery.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Those functions (including powers, duties, activities, and parts of functions) of the Department of the Army ... are hereby transferred to the National Aeronautics and Space Administration.","parent_excerpt":"All functions (including powers, duties, activities, and parts of functions) of the Department of Defense ... are hereby transferred to the National Aeronautics and Space Administration.","explanation":"Nearly identical operative transfer formula, including the distinctive five-part parenthetical and the same receiving agency."},{"child_excerpt":"The Secretary of the Treasury shall immediately transfer from such appropriations of the Department of Defense ... to such appropriations of the National Aeronautics and Space Administration ... the amount of $4,078,250.","parent_excerpt":"The Secretary of the Treasury shall immediately transfer to the appropriation of the National Aeronautics and Space Administration ... from such appropriations of the Department of Defense as the Secretary of Defense shall designate","explanation":"The same Treasury-administered mechanism transfers Defense appropriations to NASA in connection with the transferred functions."},{"child_excerpt":"The Department of Defense and the National Aeronautics and Space Administration shall effect necessary administrative arrangements, including appropriate transfer of records","parent_excerpt":"appropriate transfers of records, property, facilities, and civilian personnel shall be carried out as may be agreed upon ... by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration and the Department of Defense.","explanation":"Both direct NASA and Defense to arrange the administrative transfer of supporting records and assets."}]}
